question.text: The incentre of an equilateral triangle is (1,1) and the equation of ene side is $3 x+4 y+3=0 .$ Then, the equation of the circumeircle of the triangle is

solution.text: since, triangle is equilateral the refore incentre (1,1) lies on the centroid of the $\Delta A B C$. $\therefore G D=$ Length of perpendicular from the point $G(1,1)$ to the line $3 x+4 y+3=0$ $A G=2 G D=4$ $\therefore$ Equation of circumcircle with centre at (1,1) $$ \begin{array}{l} \text { and radius = } \begin{aligned} 4 \text { units } \\ (x-1)^{2}+(y-1)^{2} &=4^{2} \\ \Rightarrow \quad x^{2}+y^{2}-2 x-2 y-14 &=0 \end{aligned} \end{array} $$
